The topic of coding uncertainty in this corpus highlights ambiguities in medical procedure registration, specifically regarding preoperative optimization. A primary area of confusion involves the application of the procedure code [[sks-kode-naaz42|SKS-koden NAAZ42]]. According to the 2024 AKDB guidelines, there is documented uncertainty about whether this specific code may be legitimately applied if a patient is pre-optimized by an [[anaestesiolog|anæstesiolog]] working outside of designated units such as [[ima|IMA]] or the [[ita-afsnit|ITA-afsnit]] [^src1]. This ambiguity is significant because it affects how hospital departments register preoperative anesthesiological assessments, potentially leading to inconsistent clinical data and billing discrepancies depending on the physical location where the optimization takes place.

## Claims
- Der er usikkerhed om, hvorvidt procedurekoden NAAZ42 må anvendes, hvis patienten præoptimeres af en anæstesiolog uden for IMA eller ITA-afsnit [^src1] (sks-kode-naaz42, anaestesiolog, ima, ita-afsnit)
